raw_evidence.context: Rainbow Trust Children’s Charity was the University’s inaugural Charity of the Year for 2024/25, after the scheme launched in March 2024. Across the year, a series of activities helped to raise awareness of the Thames Valley Care Team and raised funds to help Rainbow Trust support families caring for a seriously ill child. The Scheme for 26/27 is expected to open in April 2026 and more information will be shared on this page nearer the time. If you have any questions, please email charityoftheyear@reading.ac.uk . We have been part of the Thames Valley for over a century now, supporting the communities that surround us. We already work with local charities in a variety of ways, through our Community Fund initiative, our community-based research projects, and more. This scheme offers our University community the chance to come together and get involved in supporting our chosen charity, and hopefully have some fun at the same time.

We received over 70 responses and have read through every comment that was shared. Due to the volume of feedback, we have identified the key themes which have been addressed in these pages, alongside outlining our next steps. This is an ongoing process and we look forward to continue working with local residents and Shinfield Parish Council to deliver excellent sport and recreation facilities in Shinfield.
